default.name: iter-1-clarify-scope
default.rationale: Iter 1 mutation: clarify that the smoke fixture is synthetic and name the engine + placeholder explicitly.
default.candidateBody:
# Smoke Skill

This skill is the runtime smoke fixture for the Hermes self-evolution engine.
It is synthetic and deterministic so verifier lanes can assert stable outcomes.

## When to use

Use this skill only as a target artifact for the engine. Never load it into a
production agent runtime.

## How it works

1. The engine reads this file as the input artifact.
2. Mock LLM responses mutate the body while preserving {{ITERATION_NAME}}.
3. Judge mocks return deterministic scores so the iterative loop picks a winner.

## Operating notes

- Preserve the {{ITERATION_NAME}} placeholder.
- Keep the top-level # Smoke Skill heading.
- Stay under the growth ceiling.
- Current iteration label: {{ITERATION_NAME}}

default.candidateBody:
# Smoke Skill

This skill is the runtime smoke fixture for the Hermes self-evolution engine.
It is synthetic, small, and deterministic.

## When to use

Use only as a target artifact for the engine. Never load into a production runtime.

## Constraints exercised

1. Placeholder preservation: {{ITERATION_NAME}} must survive every mutation.
2. Top-heading preservation: the # Smoke Skill heading must remain.
3. Growth limit: candidate body stays under 1.2x of the original.

## Operating notes

- Iteration label: {{ITERATION_NAME}}
- Do not exceed the byte budget enforced by the engine.
